title: Homogeneous slope with a micro-pile row

meta.title: Homogeneous slope with a micro-pile row
meta.notes: As V095a with a micro-pile row (1 m spacing) whose shear strength of 10.7 kN acts as a passive force tangent to the slip surface, on the reference with-pile circle (2.674, 7.376, R = 8.102).

source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V095c (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: Yamagami 1.20, commercial program B 1.223; program D 1.185 (Ito & Matsui force, active, on the no-pile circle).
On this circle the 10.7 kN passive force gives 1.172 horizontal and 1.195 tilted 51.3° (the base inclination where the circle crosses the pile).
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.
